clusters.pattern: Model incorrectly labels lack of empathy or soothing language as present; telesales only use minimal acknowledgments ('Dạ', 'Ừm', 'rồi dạ') without genuine empathetic or soothing responses.
clusters.mechanism: The model's rule for làm_dịu relies on presence of polite or minimal verbal cues rather than detecting true empathetic content or emotional engagement, leading to false positives when only generic acknowledgments are present.

clusters.pattern: Model marks làm_rõ as done despite telesales failing to ask open-ended or clarifying questions to understand customer objections or needs.
clusters.mechanism: The model's criteria for làm_rõ may be triggered by any question or statement, without verifying if the question is open-ended or truly clarifying, causing false positives when telesales ask closed or irrelevant questions.

clusters.pattern: Model marks làm_hài_lòng as present when telesales only mention benefits or programs superficially without providing concrete solutions or effective objection handling.
clusters.mechanism: The model's detection of làm_hài_lòng relies on presence of keywords related to benefits or promotions, missing the need for actual customer satisfaction or resolution of objections.

clusters.pattern: Model fails to detect missing empathy or clarifying questions after customer explicitly states refusal or lack of need; telesales proceed directly to sales pitch or closed questions.
clusters.mechanism: The model lacks integration of customer rejection signals with telesales response evaluation, causing it to miss absence of empathetic or clarifying follow-up after refusals.

clusters.pattern: Model marks làm_dịu as present even when transcript ends abruptly or telesales does not complete soothing attempt.
clusters.mechanism: The model does not verify completeness of telesales response or presence of actual soothing content, leading to false positives when calls end or telesales remain silent.
